id: title:charlesvien:retry codex turns when the model is at capacity

review.posthog_relevance: Adds error classification and detection capability for the 'Selected model is at capacity' message, categorized as 'upstream_provider_failure', potentially aiding downstream alerting and error handling.
review.reason: Adds a new error classification entry and its corresponding regex pattern to detect the message 'Selected model is at capacity. Please try a different model.', categorized as 'upstream_provider_failure'. P1.F1.H1 adds the classification entry; P1.F2.H2 incorporates the regex pattern into the classification function. This is a localized maintenance and capability addition.
review.uncertainty: The actual implementation of the regex pattern is not shown in P1.F1.H1; P1.F2.H2 shows its usage but not its definition. The benefit is limited to classification and detection, not broader systemic improvement. No evidence of actual adoption or incident avoidance.
